summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved P0 workspace control idempotency and optimistic concurrency plan. The six mutating control APIs require token auth and idempotency keys, replay the same operation for the same key plus effective payload, return structured IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT for reused keys with changed payload or If-Match, return VERSION_CONFLICT for stale If-Match before active refresh/validate coalescing, and preserve public response shapes while adding expected_version to operation and event payloads. Stale PR monitor terminal callbacks are guarded so cancelled, destroying, and destroyed workspaces are not advanced. Targeted tests, ruff, mypy, and the full unit suite pass.
